clips.title: The story
paras: At the Warsong Lumber Camp, Warsong Oil keeps the logging machinery running. A satyr ambush has carried a shipment into corrupted forest enclaves.

Warsong Oil keeps the Warsong Clan's logging machinery running in Ashenvale. Goblin-engineered shredders and massive sawmills need a steady supply of the lubricant. Without it, timber cutting could halt, slowing the lumber needed to build Orgrimmar and fortify Horde settlements across Durotar and the Barrens.

Satyrs ambushed a shipment of Warsong Oil before it could reach Splintertree Post and the logging camps. They carried the containers into corrupted enclaves, including Night Run, Satyrnaar, and Xavian, where they use the flammable lubricant in their rituals.
